---
name: act-session-closeout
description: Creates a concise repository handoff for continued work. Use at the end of a substantive repository session or before another person or Scout instance continues the work.
---

1. Record the current objective and project state.
2. Record only verified completed work, decisions, unresolved risks, and the next
   safe action.
3. Record the observed Git branch, latest commit, and working-tree state.
4. Separate current facts from historical evidence and assumptions.
5. Do not copy credentials, private Microsoft 365 content, or opaque application
   state into the handoff.
6. Use the reference checklist when a repository handoff file is being created.
